author: Elena
citation: So, we crashed for that night at an amazing beach with no one else around. ... The next morning we woke up with the first glimpse of sun, under a bunch of coconut palms, whispering the song of the wind. The night was magnificent.
location: Deserted islet beach, Togian Islands, Sulawesi, Indonesia
provenance: Personal travel account by Elena (ElenasTravelgram) published on Bunch of Backpackers, describing spending the night directly on the white sand of a remote beach after arranging with a local.

author: Verónica Santos
citation: No dia 01 de Maio de 2014, eu e o meu marido passamos a noite em Maya Bay... é hora de dormir a olhar para o céu.
location: Maya Bay, Phi Phi Islands, Thailand
provenance: First-person account by reader Verónica Santos published on 360meridianos blog, detailing an overnight tour where they spent the night on Maya Bay beach under the stars (with additional comments confirming sleeping on the sand).

author: Ryan Singlehurst-Ward (Shlub)
citation: Eventually when all the wood was gone we fell asleep where we were sitting on the sand and stayed there all night. ... After the fire had gone out we fell asleep in the sand and slept until we were awoken by fisherman going out in their boats at dawn.
provenance: Personal travel blog entry by Ryan Singlehurst-Ward on TravelBlog, February 2006, describing a night spent directly on the sand of Agonda Beach after a bonfire, covered by sand for warmth.

author: Backpack Bob
citation: We slept in tents, under the stars, pitched on the beach. ... soon we were set up with our tent pitched right next to the beach.
location: Koh Rok (Ko Rok Yai), Mu Koh Lanta National Park, Andaman Sea, Thailand
provenance: Personal travel account by Backpack Bob detailing two nights camping in a rented tent pitched directly on the beach of Koh Rok island after joining a day tour and staying overnight.
